approved_by_user: 2026-10-01 ~13:20 KST: user selected all four approaches (greedy soup of existing models, stronger tuning arms, soup including new arms, final retrain on 100%) and the rule 'no worse than V2.1' for WikiText quality.
objective: Beat the submitted V2.1 on the four benchmarks without worse WikiText-quality than V2.1.

approaches.1_soup_existing: Greedy soup (Wortsman et al., ICML 2022) over the 9 task-tune exports (3 arms x 3 epochs, including V2.1). Ingredients ranked by half-A accuracy; each added to a uniform average only if half-A accuracy does not fall.
approaches.2_stronger_arms: From V2, same data and loss as V2.1 (temperature 10, gold LM 0.5, replay 0.5): lr2e-5_e6 = LR 2e-5 for 6 epochs; lr4e-5_e3 = LR 4e-5 for 3 epochs. Exports every epoch (9 new models). Evidence: V2.1's development accuracy was still rising at epoch 3; the higher-LR smoke run learned faster.
approaches.3_soup_all: Greedy soup over all 18 fine-tuned exports.
approaches.4_full_retrain: Retrain the winning recipe on 100% of the train splits (the held-out items added after the same official-overlap check). A soup winner is retrained ingredient by ingredient and averaged the same way. If V2.1 itself wins, its recipe is retrained.

data.development: v2/data/task_tune_v1/development.jsonl (SHA256 31ae3b16...), split by a fixed content hash (round2.half_of) into half A (soup building) and half B (selection only)
data.full: v2/data/task_tune_full_v1 (prepared by the chain: train + held-out items, overlap-filtered)

selection_rule.data: half B of the held-out items (harness format) and the corpus Wikipedia selection panel (512 docs)
selection_rule.rule: Among the 9 new single models and the 2 soups, keep those whose Wikipedia bits/byte is no worse than V2.1's; take the highest half-B four-task mean; it wins only if that mean is >= V2.1's + 0.5 points. Otherwise V2.1's recipe wins.
selection_rule.record: v2/phases/round2/selection.json, frozen before any official score of a round-2 model

final_rule: The 100%-retrained version of the winning recipe becomes the final model if its Wikipedia selection bits/byte is no worse than V2.1's (half B is not held out for it, so accuracy cannot be re-checked); otherwise the 80%-trained development winner is used. This is committed before any result: official scores will not change it. If the final model is V2.1 itself, no new official evaluation is run.
official_evaluation: Pinned runner once on the final model (v2/phases/round2/final.json). V2.1 stays preserved; replacing the submission remains the user's decision, disclosed.

compute_limits.gpu: GPU 0 only; at most 2 training processes at once

disclosure: The held-out items were already used to select V2.1 and the WiSE-FT model; reusing them adds selection pressure. Half A and half B separate soup construction from selection within this phase. All earlier official scores (V2, V2.1, WiSE-FT 0.5) were observed before this phase.

commands.chain: GPU=0 bash scripts/run_round2.sh (tmux gibc-v2-round2); every step is skipped if its output exists, so rerunning resumes
commands.final: python -m scglm_v2.round2 plan-final ...; task_tune train on the retrain configs; python -m scglm_v2.round2 final ...
